description:
Altitude: 383 m. Total Elevation Gain: 1546 m. Total Distance of Trail Network: 43 km.

This trail is maintained by the Hunter's Range Snowmobile Association. Please visit their website for current seasonal information.

Hunters Range Snowmobile Association
directions: Travel Time: +/-30 minutes from Enderby. From Enderby head east on Cliff Ave. At the Enderby-Grindrod Rd intersection, continue straight onto Enderby-Mabel Lake Rd past Ashton Creek (9.5 km from Enderby) heading towards Kingfisher. At approximately 16 km from Ashton Creek you will reach Cooke Grassy Forest Service Rd which is the trailhead. Park on the left side of the road.
title: Kingfisher Laforge
